The plan violates the ordering requirement in "Why it is meaningful"/step 2: task vector 2 is computed as `subtract_: { from: base::X, to: base::X.tv2 }` after `add_` has already updated `base::X` to `base + 0.4*(ft1-base)`, so tv2 is computed as `ft2 - (base + 0.4*tv1)` rather than `ft2 - base`. This produces `out[X] = base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2 - base - 0.4*(ft1-base))`, which is not the required `base + lambda*(ft1-base) + lambda*(ft2-base)`, breaking the Frobenius-error grading tolerance for the 48 merged tensors.
